headline: Meta expands AI age-detection on Instagram worldwide
summary: Meta is expanding its AI age-guessing technology for Instagram teen accounts globally, and will also increase its use of the tech on Facebook and Threads.

claims.statement: Meta will use AI technology to look for clues that a user is a teenager, even if they entered an adult birthday, expanding the tech globally.

sources.quote: Meta expands Instagram’s AI age-guessing tech globally
Meta says it will use its AI technology to look for clues about people it suspects to be teenagers — even if they use an adult birthday.

claims.statement: Meta will increase its use of the age-detection technology on Facebook and Threads as well.

sources.quote: The company will increase its use of the tech on Facebook and Threads too.
